_comment: Harness config. limits: the Big-plan spend caps (USD) the proxy enforces per workflow run and per rolling week. models: what CodeAF may use, served to it by `harness proxy` as an OpenRouter-shaped catalog; prices are USD per million tokens, from https://synthetic.new/pricing, checked 2026-10-17. input/output/cache_read are the SUBSCRIPTION rates, which draw down the weekly credit; api_input/api_cached/api_output are the API list rates, what usage past the quota (overage) costs. 'id' is what CodeAF sees; 'upstream' is the synthetic.new model id. 'max_concurrent': the synthetic.new subscription allows 2 calls to each model at once; the proxy queues calls past that.

limits.plan_note: Big plan $90/mo. The weekly credit is not published; 20 is a conservative ASSUMPTION (~$90/4.33 weeks at subscription rates; calibrate from GET /v2/quotas subscription.limit once known). run_credit_usd replaces the old run_usd. overage_usd 0 = stop rather than pay past the quota. Sized so several overlapping runs (task.parallel 2) share the week.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: low, minimal and medium requests are sent as high, because GLM returns empty answers at low. medium was measured (2026-10-17, a real multi-step Go edit-and-test task through the live proxy, 3 repeats per case) to save 19.3% median completion tokens and 17.8% median wall time at equal correctness, which is under the 20% threshold that measurement set for switching, so high is kept (results.md, issue #24)

models.name: GLM-5.3 (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: low, minimal and medium are all sent as medium: equal correctness (3/3 vs 3/3, 0 empty answers, 0 malformed tool calls) and a real saving (median completion 1332->854, i.e. 35.9% fewer; median wall 26.3->17.8 s, 32.1% less), so medium is sent raw to synthetic.new; low is still never sent raw because GLM returns an empty answer (tested 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16; measured 2026-10-17, results.md, issue #24)
